request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBACT04C-003: Interest rate lookup by account group, transaction type and category, falling back to the DEFAULT group

### given[0]: The disclosure group file is keyed by account group ID (10 characters), then transaction type code (2 characters), then transaction category code (4 digits).
fields=['FD-DISCGRP-KEY', 'FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID', 'FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD', 'FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
    74            05 FD-XREF-FILLER                    PIC X(14).
    75 
    76        FD  DISCGRP-FILE.
    77        01  FD-DISCGRP-REC.
>>  78            05 FD-DISCGRP-KEY.
>>  79               10 FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID           PIC X(10).
>>  80               10 FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD            PIC X(02).
>>  81               10 FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD             PIC 9(04).
    82            05 FD-DISCGRP-DATA                   PIC X(34).
    83 
    84        FD  ACCOUNT-FILE.
    85        01  FD-ACCTFILE-REC.

### given[1]: The interest rate in the disclosure group record is a signed number with 4 integer digits and 2 decimal places.
fields=['DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=[]
CVTRA02Y.cpy:
     5            05  DIS-GROUP-KEY.
     6               10 DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID                     PIC X(10).
     7               10 DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD                      PIC X(02).
     8               10 DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD                       PIC 9(04).
>>   9            05  DIS-INT-RATE                            PIC S9(04)V99.
    10            05  FILLER                                  PIC X(28).
    11       *
    12       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:00 CDT
    13       *

### given[2]: The lookup key is made from the account's group ID (from the account record), the category code and the type code of the current transaction category balance record.
fields=['ACCT-GROUP-ID', 'FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID', 'TRANCAT-CD', 'FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD', 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD', 'FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   206                      END-IF
   207       *              DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID: ' ACCT-GROUP-ID
   208       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-CD: ' TRANCAT-CD
   209       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD: ' TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
>> 210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
>> 211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
>> 212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
   213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
   214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
   215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
   216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES

### when[0]: The disclosure group record is read by that key for each transaction category balance record.
fields=[] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   209       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD: ' TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
   210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
   212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
>> 213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
   214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
   215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
   216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
   217                      END-IF

### when[1]: A read that succeeds (status 00) or finds no record (status 23) is accepted. Any other status stops the program with an abend.
fields=['DISCGRP-STATUS', 'APPL-RESULT'] literals=['00', '23', 'ERROR READING DISCLOSURE GROUP FILE']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   418                    DISPLAY 'DISCLOSURE GROUP RECORD MISSING'
   419                    DISPLAY 'TRY WITH DEFAULT GROUP CODE'
   420            END-READ.
   421 
>> 422            IF  DISCGRP-STATUS  = '00'  OR '23'
>> 423                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 424            ELSE
>> 425                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 426            END-IF
>> 427 
>> 428            IF  APPL-AOK
>> 429                CONTINUE
>> 430            ELSE
>> 431                DISPLAY 'ERROR READING DISCLOSURE GROUP FILE'
>> 432                MOVE DISCGRP-STATUS  TO IO-STATUS
>> 433                PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
>> 434                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
>> 435            END-IF
   436            IF  DISCGRP-STATUS  = '23'
   437                MOVE 'DEFAULT' TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   438                PERFORM 1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE
   439            END-IF

### then[0]: If a record is found for the exact key, its interest rate is the one used.
fields=['DIS-GROUP-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   412            END-IF
   413            EXIT.
   414       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   415        1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE.
>> 416            READ DISCGRP-FILE INTO DIS-GROUP-RECORD
   417                 INVALID KEY
   418                    DISPLAY 'DISCLOSURE GROUP RECORD MISSING'
   419                    DISPLAY 'TRY WITH DEFAULT GROUP CODE'
   420            END-READ.

### then[1]: If no record is found (status 23), only the group ID in the key is replaced with 'DEFAULT'. The same transaction type and category codes are kept, and the record is read again.
fields=['DISCGRP-STATUS', 'FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID'] literals=['23', 'DEFAULT']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   432                MOVE DISCGRP-STATUS  TO IO-STATUS
   433                PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
   434                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
   435            END-IF
>> 436            IF  DISCGRP-STATUS  = '23'
>> 437                MOVE 'DEFAULT' TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
>> 438                PERFORM 1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE
>> 439            END-IF
   440            EXIT.
   441 
   442       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   443        1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE.

### then[2]: The rate from the DEFAULT record is then used. If the DEFAULT read does not return status 00 (including when no DEFAULT record exists for that type and category), the program abends.
fields=['DIS-GROUP-RECORD', 'DISCGRP-STATUS', 'APPL-RESULT'] literals=['00', 'ERROR READING DEFAULT DISCLOSURE GROUP']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   440            EXIT.
   441 
   442       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   443        1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE.
>> 444            READ DISCGRP-FILE INTO DIS-GROUP-RECORD
>> 445 
>> 446            IF  DISCGRP-STATUS  = '00'
>> 447                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 448            ELSE
>> 449                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
>> 450            END-IF
>> 451 
>> 452            IF  APPL-AOK
>> 453                CONTINUE
>> 454            ELSE
>> 455                DISPLAY 'ERROR READING DEFAULT DISCLOSURE GROUP'
>> 456                MOVE DISCGRP-STATUS  TO IO-STATUS
>> 457                PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
>> 458                PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
>> 459            END-IF
   460            EXIT.
   461       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   462        1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST.
   463 

### then[3]: Interest and fees are computed for this category balance only when the rate found is not zero. A zero rate skips both.
fields=['DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
   212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
   213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
>> 214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
>> 215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
>> 216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
>> 217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
   219                ELSE
   220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   221                END-IF

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 78-81 define FD-DISCGRP-KEY as the group ID X(10), then type code X(02), then category code 9(04), in that order."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 9 defines DIS-INT-RATE as PIC S9(04)V99: signed, with 4 integer digits and 2 decimal places."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 210-212 move ACCT-GROUP-ID, TRANCAT-CD and TRANCAT-TYPE-CD into the three key fields."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":false,"reason":"Line 213 only performs 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE; the READ itself (line 416) and the per-record loop are not in the cited span."},{"clause":"when[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 422-435 accept status '00' or '23' and otherwise display 'ERROR READING DISCLOSURE GROUP FILE' and perform 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 416 reads the record for the current key into DIS-GROUP-RECORD, which loads the matching record's interest rate."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 436-439 change only FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID to 'DEFAULT' when status is '23', then perform the default read, so the other key fields are kept."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 444-459 read the DEFAULT record into DIS-GROUP-RECORD and abend with 'ERROR READING DEFAULT DISCLOSURE GROUP' when the status is not '00'."},{"clause":"then[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 214-217 perform 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST and 1400-COMPUTE-FEES only when DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0, so a zero rate skips both."}]}
